claims.text: The proposed model outperforms previous extractive and abstractive models on ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and METEOR scores.
The improvements over the Baseline model indicate that the model effectively identifies important sentences, especially in longer documents.
The benefits of the model become stronger as document length increases, outperforming traditional methods by a narrow margin overall.
